changelog.summary: Fast context includes Life 2025 dates and household inventory (stuff we own)
Fast Telegram context is a full Brian knowledge snapshot, refreshed to Redis every runner cycle
Fast Telegram replies default to Gemini 3.7 Flash
knowledge_update acknowledgments must say queued for async/nightly ingest; never claim realtime knowledge writes
Fast-chat context now includes 2026-27 schools and teacher roster facts on herbert-children.md
Telegram fast bot is queue-only for async work; Cursor owns durable Telegram review from committed transcript and per-message review tasks
Health endpoint exposes fast-context hash, files, length, and Nathan birthdate sentinel for deployment freshness checks
Unanswered text questions now return fixed DEFER reply; removed extra local-fallback suffix
Photo replies: preserve newlines (label, description, caption only); remove LLM ack line
Telegram-only chat; async Cursor via scheduled inbox triage; removed Google Chat and live repository_dispatch
Persistent Redis history: last 20 messages per chat (no TTL by default)
